reason: A Windows one-click launcher that bundles the runtime for DeepSeek Harness, starts its local web interface, opens it in the default browser, and manages the process from the system tray.

summaries.zh: 一个面向 Windows 的免安装启动器，用于打包运行环境、启动本地 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面并通过系统托盘管理服务。
summaries.en: A portable Windows launcher that bundles the runtime, starts a local DeepSeek Harness web interface, opens it in the default browser, and provides system-tray process management.

capabilities: bundles and extracts a Node.js-based runtime locally
starts a local DeepSeek Harness web service
stores application data, sessions, configuration, and logs in the user profile
requires a user-provided DeepSeek API key for online use
